question.problem:
A discrete random variable $X$ has the probability mass function $f(x)$ shown in the table below. Find $\text{E}[{e}^{X}].$

| $x$ | $-1$ | $0$ | $1$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ | $\frac{3}{4}$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ |
question.worked_solution:
For a discrete random variable $X$ and a function $r(x),$ the rule of the lazy statistician states that 

$$
\text{E}[r(X)]={\sum }_{x\in S}r(x)f(x).
$$

In our case, we have 

$$
r(x)={e}^{x}.
$$

 

Therefore, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[{e}^{X}] & ={\sum }_{x\in S}{e}^{x}\,f(x) \\  & ={e}^{-1}\cdot \frac{1}{8}+{e}^{0}\cdot \frac{3}{4}+{e}^{1}\cdot \frac{1}{8} \\  & ={e}^{-1}\cdot \frac{1}{8}+1\cdot \frac{3}{4}+e\cdot \frac{1}{8} \\  & =\frac{{e}^{-1}}{8}+\frac{3}{4}+\frac{e}{8} \\  & =\frac{{e}^{-1}+6+e}{8}.\end{aligned}
$$
